description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: L-shaped sofa in upper right area facing the central coffee table and TV unit on the right wall. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, 19 m² — large enough for bunk beds. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: one wardrobe. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. 1 separate WC. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child; two adults sharing independently — each with private bathroom access; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: home office workers needing a dedicated desk space; households requiring walk-in storage or wardrobes.
